facts.text: The task registers the Gymnasium id Isaac-WarpAUV-Direct-v1 with WarpAUVEnv as its entry point
The registration disables the Gymnasium environment checker
WarpAUVEnv is a DirectRLEnv subclass
The action space is Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(6,)): six continuous inputs in the range -1.0 to 1.0
The six actions are PWM commands between -1 and 1, one per thruster
The observation space is Box(-inf, inf, shape=(17,))
The observation concatenates the goal, the offset from the origin in the body frame, the root quaternion, the body-frame linear velocity and the body-frame angular velocity
The simulation physics timestep is 1/120 s
The configuration sets decimation = 2
The episode length cap is enabled with episode_length_s = 3.0
The configuration enables boundaries with max_auv_x = 7, max_auv_y = 7 and max_auv_z = 7
The done flags returned by _get_dones are the out-of-bounds flags and the time-out flags
starting_depth is 8
The robot's initial position is (0.0, 0.0, starting_depth)
goal_spawn_radius is 2.0
A reset offsets the initial position by a sample from a sphere of radius goal_spawn_radius
A reset draws the goal orientation from a random orientation
Actions are clipped to the range -1 to 1 before the dynamics are computed
Thruster commands with absolute value below 0.08 are zeroed; from 0.08 upward the command is converted by -139*v^2 + 500*v + 8.28 and from -0.08 downward by 161*v^2 + 517.86*v - 5.72
rotor_constant is 0.1/100.0
The rotor force conversion returns rotorConstant * |value| * value
The first-order rotor time constant is 0.05 s
The rotor update sets alpha to zero so the state follows the command
The dynamics allocate six thrusters per environment
The water density is 997.0 kg/m^3 and the dynamic viscosity is 0.001306 Pa s
The AUV mass is 22.701 kg and the volume is 0.022747843530591776 m^3, which the comment describes as neutrally buoyant
The inertia tensor used by the dynamics is (0.37, 0.97, 1.19)
The centre-of-buoyancy offset is [0.0, 0.0, 0.01] m
The quadratic drag force on each body axis is -2*rho*rj*rk*|v|*v and the viscous force is -6*beta*pi*r_eq*v
The reward scales are position 0.2, angle 0.5 and actions 0.2, with linear velocity, angular velocity and terminated at 0.0
The total reward is the sum of the angular, action, position and angular-velocity terms

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial position and goal of the fake, and the integration is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the fake draws with Python's random.Random while upstream uses torch and numpy generators, so a seed does not reproduce upstream trajectories

gaps: the fake backend is a reduced pure-Python model, not IsaacSim/PhysX: no contacts, no GPU physics, no domain randomization of mass or volume, no sensor or noise model, and its initial orientation and velocities are placeholders

the fake integrates thrust, quadratic drag and viscous drag in one 1/120 s step per env.step, while the upstream environment runs decimation=2 physics substeps per control step and uses PhysX for the rigid-body integration; ticks therefore name fake timesteps, not upstream control steps
the clone configures four parallel environments in one scene; the fake serves one environment and a 17-element observation

buoyancy and gravity are assumed to cancel, following the clone's comment that the volume makes the body neutrally buoyant; the fake does not model the small net buoyancy or the buoyancy torque from the centre-of-buoyancy offset
the angular reward uses 1 - dot(goal, quaternion)^2 as a stand-in for the upstream quat_error_magnitude; no rendering is offered
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, so ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
no snapshot or restore: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state
the fake was not compared with an IsaacSim/IsaacLab run; the upstream stack (IsaacSim 4.5.0, IsaacLab 2.2.0 and a GPU) was not installed or run here

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
